gui.komaedit.capability.title: Capabilities
gui.komaedit.capability.tweak.auto: the first one of the block
gui.komaedit.capability.hint.extrude: Wheel: up to %s blocks · Right click: same %s
gui.komaedit.capability.hint.tweak: Property: %s · F with empty hands changes it
gui.komaedit.capability.hint.smear_cance: Right click: drop the pending origin
gui.komaedit.capability.replace.desc: Right click swaps the targeted block for the one in your hand and keeps its properties: stairs for stairs, slab for slab.
gui.komaedit.capability.tweak.desc: Right click with an empty hand cycles the chosen property (facing, half, shape…); sneak to go back.
gui.komaedit.capability.extrude.desc: Holding the same block: right click a face to copy the connected layer outwards; left click shrinks it.
gui.komaedit.capability.smear.desc: Right click sets the origin (sneak for the whole row); the second click stretches it along the face axis to where you look.
gui.komaedit.capability.angel.desc: Right click while looking at the air places the block at the chosen distance, no support needed.
gui.komaedit.capability.reach.desc: Reach blocks much further away, up to the server limit.
gui.komaedit.capability.fastplace.desc: No delay between blocks while holding right click.
gui.komaedit.capability.noupdates.desc: Place and break without updating neighbours: floating sand, still water.
gui.komaedit.title: KomaEdit Procedural Studio
gui.komaedit.stage.path.subtitle: Place, move and review the nodes
gui.komaedit.stage.figure.subtitle: What gets built along the path, pillars, arches and bridges too
gui.komaedit.stage.instances.subtitle: Figures you already built: pick one to change or remove it
gui.komaedit.stage.recipes.subtitle: Save the figure with all its settings to use it again or share it
gui.komaedit.stage.color.subtitle: Gradients, similar blocks and shading
gui.komaedit.build_large: Large build: ≈ %s blocks · press Build again within 5 s to confirm
gui.komaedit.help.build: Builds the recipe along the path (B). Builds over 250,000 blocks ask for a second press.
gui.komaedit.search.empty: No results · try another name or a command alias
gui.komaedit.search.typing: Type to filter · Enter picks the first · Esc clears
gui.komaedit.help.favorite_star: ★ on the right: add to or remove from favorites
gui.komaedit.preset.compact.help: Smaller and tighter: radius ×0.6 and one step less spacing.
gui.komaedit.preset.default.help: Back to the figure's default proportions, keeping options and modifiers.
gui.komaedit.preset.wide.help: Bigger and looser: radius ×1.5 and one step more spacing.
gui.komaedit.preset.bold.help: Radius ×1.2 and one more point of thickness.
gui.komaedit.preset.random.help: Seeded variant around the default proportions (R). Z undoes it.
gui.komaedit.variant.applied: Variant #%s · R for another, Z to go back
gui.komaedit.hologram.hidden: Hologram hidden · H shows it again
gui.komaedit.number.typing: Type the value · Enter applies, Esc cancels
gui.komaedit.number.invalid: Invalid value · the previous one is kept
gui.komaedit.reset_done: Default value restored · Z undoes it
gui.komaedit.help.radius: How wide the figure is around the path. It changes the block count the most.
gui.komaedit.help.spacing: How often the pattern repeats along the path (or how many sides, threads or strands it has, depending on the figure).
gui.komaedit.help.thickness: How thick the pieces are: the tube wall, the strand, the core or the relief.
gui.komaedit.help.roll: Turns the whole figure around the path, like turning a tube in your hand.
gui.komaedit.help.height: How tall the structure is (or how far apart the clouds are).
gui.komaedit.help.dither: How much the blocks mix where two of the gradient meet.
gui.komaedit.help.start_scale: How big the figure is at the start of the path, over its normal size.
gui.komaedit.help.end_scale: How big the figure is at the end of the path, over its normal size: below 100 %% it tapers.
gui.komaedit.help.start_spacing: How far apart the pieces are at the start, over normal.
gui.komaedit.help.end_spacing: How far apart the pieces are at the end, over normal.
gui.komaedit.help.twist: How much the figure turns around itself from start to end: 360° is one full turn.
gui.komaedit.help.rhythm_interval: Every how many segments of the path the other figure appears.
gui.komaedit.help.conform_radius: How far each point looks for the ground (or the ceiling); beyond that, the point stays where it is.
gui.komaedit.help.surface_offset: How high the figure sits above the ground; negative sinks it.
gui.komaedit.help.socket_interval: Every how many blocks of the path the copy goes.
gui.komaedit.help.option.engine: Classic, as always, or exact: no gaps, with ends, normals and pieces.
gui.komaedit.help.option.preset: The default formula of the Expression figure. From your own formula, the first click goes back to the default.
gui.komaedit.help.option.profile: The shape of the tube's cross-section: circle, star, rope…
gui.komaedit.help.option.hollow: Solid or hollow; hollow, the thickness is the wall.
gui.komaedit.help.option.end: How the tips of the tube are closed.
gui.komaedit.help.option.normal: Which way the cross-section faces in bends: follows the curve, always flat or always upright.
gui.komaedit.help.option.smooth: Full blocks, or slabs and stairs on the surface so it is not stepped.
gui.komaedit.help.option.coverage: How much of the surface turns into slabs and stairs.
gui.komaedit.help.option.accent: The figure that appears on top every few segments.
gui.komaedit.help.option.socket_placemen: Where the copy goes: at the tips, at every point, every few blocks or bent along the path.
gui.komaedit.help.top.help: Keyboard shortcuts and color theme (F1 or ?)
gui.komaedit.help.top.hologram: Show or hide the hologram (H); the block count is still computed
gui.komaedit.help.top.undo: Undo Studio setting (Z); the world is undone with Ctrl+Z
gui.komaedit.shortcuts.title: Studio shortcuts
gui.komaedit.shortcuts.close: Esc, F1 or click to close
gui.komaedit.theme.slate.help: Blue-grey slate with a lapis blue accent. The default.
gui.komaedit.theme.prismarine.help: Deep sea blue with a turquoise accent, like the ocean monuments.
gui.komaedit.theme.forest.help: Moss and spruce greens with a sage green accent.
gui.komaedit.theme.classic.help: Light, with the inventory's grey stone and the enchanting purple.
gui.komaedit.shortcut.stage: Go to a stage (in side bar order)
gui.komaedit.shortcut.build: Build (large builds ask to confirm; in Tools, the chosen tool)
gui.komaedit.shortcut.variant: Random seeded variant (in Tools, a new seed)
gui.komaedit.shortcut.help: This cheat sheet; the color theme is at the bottom
gui.komaedit.shortcut.wheel: Over the buttons or value: change it; elsewhere: scroll
gui.komaedit.shortcut.big_step: Big steps with − + or the wheel
gui.komaedit.shortcut.drag: On a number: drag to change it (with Shift, fine) and click to type it
gui.komaedit.path.how.click: Click in the world: adds a node where the mouse points (also from Figures).
gui.komaedit.path.how.move: Drag a node over the terrain to move it; its X, Y, Z arrows move it along one axis (to raise or lower it). Drag a segment to insert a node in between.
gui.komaedit.path.how.camera: Right click and drag turns the camera; W, A, S, D move you.
gui.komaedit.help.path.add_here: Adds a node where you stand (like /komaedit path here).
gui.komaedit.help.path.toggle_closed: A closed path joins the last node to the first (needs 3).
gui.komaedit.help.path.clear: Removes every node (Ctrl+Delete). The world is not changed.
gui.komaedit.help.formula: Click to type the formula · Enter applies, Esc cancels, Ctrl+V pastes.
gui.komaedit.help.option.easing: Whether the change is even from start to end or shows more at the start or at the end.
gui.komaedit.help.close_gaps: Fills the one-block holes that tight bends leave.
gui.komaedit.help.remove_isolated: Removes blocks left on their own, with no neighbours.
gui.komaedit.material.library_hint: The library has every registered block, other mods included.
gui.komaedit.blocks.title: Block library
gui.komaedit.color.shade_hint: Recolours the selection's surface by the light: faces that look at it, light; corners and shadows, dark. Drag in the world to select. //undo undoes it.
gui.komaedit.help.color.pick: Pick the block from the catalog.
gui.komaedit.help.color.steps: Blocks in the gradient, counting both ends.
gui.komaedit.help.color.cubes: Only full, solid, opaque blocks: no slabs, glass or leaves.
gui.komaedit.help.color.anything: Lets ores, glazed terracotta, machines and light sources in.
gui.komaedit.help.color.to_hotbar: Puts the gradient in your hotbar (creative; can be undone).
gui.komaedit.help.color.another: Tries other blocks while staying close to the color.
gui.komaedit.help.color.light: Where the light comes from. Compass points come in at 45°.
gui.komaedit.help.color.palette: From the selection uses its materials dark to light; the ramp builds tones around the main material.
gui.komaedit.help.color.dither: Mixes neighboring palette blocks at the transitions so there are no bands.
gui.komaedit.instance.empty: Nothing built yet. Every new Build will show up here.
gui.komaedit.help.instance.update: Rebuilds the instance with the current settings, on its original path.
gui.komaedit.recipe.name: recipe_name
gui.komaedit.recipe.empty: No recipes yet. Set up a figure and press Save.
gui.komaedit.help.recipe.name: Letters, numbers, _ and -. It also names what you build.
gui.komaedit.help.recipe.export: Saves the recipe as a .krecipe file in config/komaedit/packages, to pass it on.
gui.komaedit.hologram.server_adjusted: Base hologram · terrain and kitbash are completed when building
gui.komaedit.status.engine.exact: Exact engine · no gaps, with ends, normals and pieces
gui.komaedit.status.engine.classic: Classic engine · the figure is stamped with brushes
gui.komaedit.status.formula.typing: Type the formula · Enter applies, Esc cancels, Ctrl+V pastes
gui.komaedit.status.formula.custom: Custom formula applied · whatever gives > 0 is built
gui.komaedit.status.profile.sides: Profile %s · Sides / points sets how many
gui.komaedit.status.hollow.on: Hollow tube · Wall sets the thickness in blocks
gui.komaedit.status.normal.consistent: Continuous normals · the section rolls smoothly through curves
gui.komaedit.status.normal.horizontal: Horizontal normals · the top face keeps facing the sky
gui.komaedit.status.normal.upright: Upright normals · the section stays aligned with the Y axis
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.slabs: Slabs on the surface · same material as the pattern
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.stairs: Slabs and stairs on the surface · Coverage decides how many
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.stairs2d: Straight slabs and stairs · corners only where Minecraft forces them
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.layers: Snow layers on the ground · 1/8 block steps
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.ssw: Slabs, stairs and walls · walls for thin columns
gui.komaedit.status.smooth.panes: Panes · glass panes or iron bars joined to their neighbours
gui.komaedit.status.coverage.full: Coverage 100%% · the whole surface gets pieces
gui.komaedit.status.modifiers.reset: Variations removed · the figure is the same from start to end
gui.komaedit.status.node.selected: Node %s selected · drag an X, Y or Z arrow
gui.komaedit.status.instance.updated: Update sent · keeps the original path
gui.komaedit.status.instance.selected: Instance picked · change settings and press Update
gui.komaedit.status.build.sent: Build sent · the points stay until you press Clear
hud.komaedit.path.title: KomaEdit · path capture
hud.komaedit.path.hint: K opens the Studio  ·  P ends capture  ·  /ke path points
komaedit.shape.spiked_scales.description: Separate diamonds with a raised spike and a solid core
komaedit.shape.beads.description: Rounded volumes spaced along the path
komaedit.shape.coil.description: Continuous helix like a spring, cable or root
komaedit.shape.lightning.description: Jagged 3D bolt with branches; closed, it makes a hollow crown
komaedit.shape.crowns.description: Toothed floral loops with alternating rotation
komaedit.shape.fishnet.description: Mesh of crossed helical threads wrapping the path
komaedit.shape.oscillate.description: Volumetric ribbon that waves and turns
komaedit.shape.ribloops.description: Repeated open arches with a lengthwise spine
komaedit.shape.tiles.description: Tilted square plates wrapping the path
komaedit.shape.hexarmor.description: Raised hexagonal panels over a tubular skin
komaedit.shape.voronoi.description: Organic mesh of irregular cells with depth
komaedit.shape.knots.description: Alternating toroidal knots for biomechanical surfaces
komaedit.shape.noodles.description: Bundle of crossed, textured organic tubes
komaedit.shape.clouds.description: Cloud volume with masses, lobes, crowns and eroded trails
komaedit.shape.web.description: Thin bridge between thick knots, or a classic web of spokes and arcs
komaedit.shape.sweep.description: 2D profile (circle, star, rope…) swept in tube space, watertight and without bridges
komaedit.shape.braid.description: Figure-eight strands crossing over and under along the path
komaedit.shape.noisetube.description: Solid tube whose crust is bitten by 3D noise that follows the curve
komaedit.shape.expression.description: Figure defined by a formula in tube space: x and y across the section, z along it
komaedit.shape.pillar.description: Epic column between P1 and P2 with base, shaft, ribs and capital
komaedit.shape.pillararches.description: Two monumental pillars from P1 and P2 joined by an ornate arch
komaedit.shape.torii.description: Giant Japanese gate with leaning pillars, curved beams, brackets and a central plaque
komaedit.shape.archbridge.description: Walkable bridge with an arch, parapets and ribs
komaedit.metric.axis.help: Spreads the palette along the chosen axis.
komaedit.metric.exposure.help: What faces the sky and open air gets the end of the palette.
komaedit.metric.cavity.help: Corners and hollows darken with the start of the palette.
komaedit.metric.edges.help: Ridges and edges stand out with the end of the palette.
komaedit.metric.curvature.help: Separates convex areas from concave ones.
komaedit.metric.organic.help: Soft noise patches, like natural stone or moss.
komaedit.metric.figure.help: Local pattern adapted to the figure's geometry.
komaedit.metric.motif.help: Restarts the gradient between the root and the front of each motif.
komaedit.metric.relief.help: Separates core, depth and raised areas.
komaedit.metric.alternate.help: Alternates two palette ranges between consecutive rows.
komaedit.formula.windows.description: Tube with n windows per turn and a continuous floor
komaedit.formula.rails.description: Two rails on sleepers, like a track
komaedit.formula.stripes.description: Solid core with n raised spiral stripes
komaedit.formula.lattice.description: Skin of diagonally crossed bars, n per turn
komaedit.formula.ribs.description: Rings every 6/n radii joined by a keel
komaedit.symmetry.center.none: not set (it goes where you stand when you turn it on)
komaedit.symmetry.worldedit.on: Your WorldEdit and KomaEdit edits are mirrored too, in the same //undo
komaedit.symmetry.worldedit.off: Your WorldEdit and KomaEdit edits are no longer mirrored
komaedit.symmetry.hover.on: Turns symmetry on with this center
komaedit.symmetry.hover.here: Center on the block you stand in
komaedit.symmetry.hover.half: Center on the nearest edge between blocks
komaedit.symmetry.hover.selection: Center on the middle of the WorldEdit selection
komaedit.symmetry.hover.worldedit: Mirror your WorldEdit and KomaEdit edits too
komaedit.symmetry.warn.radial: Warning: in radial mode the center must be on a block in both X and Z, or between blocks in both; otherwise some copies skip blocks. Use center here or center here half xz
komaedit.symmetry.warn.world: The symmetry is in %s and does nothing here; use center here to bring it
komaedit.symmetry.missed: Symmetry · %s of %s copies not made (occupied, protected area or outside the world)
komaedit.symmetry.limit: Symmetry · copies stopped at %s blocks: that is the limit per edit
gui.komaedit.stage.tools.subtitle: Trees, roofs, terrain, utilities, symmetry and capabilities
gui.komaedit.shortcut.cancel_job: Cancel what is running or discard the preview
gui.komaedit.job.confirm.help: Applies exactly what the preview shows (/komaedit confirm). Shortcut: Enter.
gui.komaedit.job.discard.help: Discards the preview without touching the world (/komaedit cancel). Shortcut: Ctrl+Backspace.
gui.komaedit.job.cancel.help: Stops reading, calculating or placing (/komaedit cancel). What was already placed stays in a single //undo. Shortcut: Ctrl+Backspace.
gui.komaedit.tools.search.help: By name, command, alias or description. Enter picks the first one; Esc clears.
gui.komaedit.tools.favorites.empty: Mark tools with the ★ to see them here
gui.komaedit.tools.command.help: Click: copy the command to the clipboard. Build sends exactly this command.
gui.komaedit.tools.block.help: Click: pick from the block library · Right click: back to the default
gui.komaedit.tools.preview.help: Build asks for the universal preview: it is shown in the world and waits for Confirm or Discard in the footer. Applies to every tool that supports it.
gui.komaedit.tools.random.help: New random seed; every other setting stays the same (R).
gui.komaedit.tools.biome.none: The world has not sent its biomes yet
gui.komaedit.tools.target.look: Placed where you click in the world (without a click, at the center of the screen).
gui.komaedit.tools.target.path_or_look: One at each path point or, without points, where you click.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.path_or_look.n: No points: click in the world where it goes and drag the ghost to move it.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.path_or_look.p: One at each of the %s path points.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.path_or_select: Follows the path or, without one, the WorldEdit selection.
Mark points in Path or drag in the world to select a box.
No path: uses the WorldEdit selection.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.selection: Works on the selection: drag it in the world and pull its faces to adjust it.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.selection.none: Works on the selection, and there is none now: drag it in the world.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.hand: Ends up as a brush in your hand: then click in the world to paint with it.
gui.komaedit.tools.target.mode: A mode that stays on until you turn it off.
gui.komaedit.tools.status.bad_name: The name takes 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, _ or -
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.no_selection: Drag in the world to select the area (or use //pos1 and //pos2)
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.no_path_or_se: Mark at least two path points or drag a selection in the world
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.loft_points: Mark at least %s points (each curve in a row) or type saved paths
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.illegal_chara: “%s” has a character the chat does not accept (§ or control)
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.curve_name: “%s” is not a path name (letters, digits, _ and -)
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.curve_count: Type 2 to 6 saved paths, or none to use the points
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.stamp_name: “%s” is not a stamp name (letters, digits, _ and -)
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.drops: Hydraulic erosion accepts up to %s drops per column
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.thermal_stren: Thermal erosion strength goes from 0.1 to %s
gui.komaedit.tools.problem.creative_only: Capabilities only work in creative (or with komaedit.admin.anymode)
gui.komaedit.tools.action.save_preset.he: Saves these settings under a name (#name) to use them later.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.estimate.help: Estimate only: blocks, chunks, box, memory and time (-e). Changes nothing.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.center_here.he: Puts the center on the block you stand on.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.center_half.he: Puts the center on the nearest edge between blocks: even-width builds.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.center_selecti: Puts the center in the middle of the WorldEdit selection.
gui.komaedit.tools.param.heading: Lean heading
gui.komaedit.tools.placeholder.curves: empty: current points · e.g. edge1 edge2
gui.komaedit.tools.placeholder.custom: name of a PNG in config/komaedit/heightmaps
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.young.help: Short, thin and with a small crown.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.old.help: Thick trunk, wide crown, more branches and more twisted.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.windswept.help: Leaning 25° with twisted branches, like on a windy cliff.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.with_dormers.h: Gable with two dormers per long eave.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.mountain.help: Radius 24 mountain at its natural height, turned at random.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.hills.help: Rolling hills in maximum mode: go over the same spot without them piling up.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.dunes.help: Dune field with sand (its category's palette).
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.monument.help: Size 16 letters, 3 deep, with border and slabs and stairs.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.dusting.help: One even layer, no drifts in hollows.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.drifts.help: Three layers that pile up in hollows and shade, covering grass.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.peaks.help: More snow the higher it is.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.description: Procedural tree with a tapering trunk, self-distributing branches, roots and a lumpy crown; where you click or as a brush. /komaedit tree
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.species: How it grows and its default materials.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.height: How tall the tree grows; on auto, the species' height.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.thickness: A thicker or thinner trunk, and every branch with it.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.branches: How many branches grow from the trunk.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.density: How leafy the crown is; at 0 it has no leaves.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.heading: Which way it leans: 0 east, 90 south; on auto, random.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.curvature: How much the trunk and branches wind.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.seed: Another number, another tree with the same settings; on auto, a new one every time.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.trunk: Trunk and branches (-t); several blocks make streaks.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.roots: Roots gripping the ground (-r no removes them).
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.root_block: Root material; defaults to the trunk.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.variation: How different the trees are from each other when you plant several.
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.mask: WorldEdit mask: where it may place blocks (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.description: Faceted, cracked and shaded rock sunk into the ground; or a crag or spire. Where you click or as a brush. /komaedit rock
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.type: Rounded boulder, layered crag or spire.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.size: How big the rock is; on auto, the type's size.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.aspect: How tall it is compared with how wide.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.elongation: How elongated it is seen from above; ×1 is round.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.roughness: How rough the surface comes out.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.cracks: How many cracks and layers show.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.sink: How deep it sinks into the ground.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.seed: Another number, another rock with the same settings; on auto, a new one every time.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.palette: Blocks from dark to light, comma separated, or ##palette (-b).
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.moss: How much moss grows on top and in the corners.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.variation: How different they are from each other when you place several.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.mask: WorldEdit mask: where it may place blocks (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.description: Full roof over the selection footprint, with stairs, corners and slabs placed right. Select at the height of the wall tops. /komaedit roof
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.material: Full block; stairs and slabs come from its family.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.overhang: How far the roof sticks out past the walls.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.thickness: How thick the roof slope is.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.dormers: How many dormers on each long side (9 blocks or more).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.wall: Gables, dormer walls and parapet (-m); defaults to the walls.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.side: Low side of a shed roof (-lado).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.sides: How many sides the spire has.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.height: How tall the dome, cone, spire or pagoda is.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.parapet: How tall the low wall of the flat roof is.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.break: How far the steep part goes down before it breaks.
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.detect: The footprint comes from the walls inside the selection (-d).
gui.komaedit.tools.roof.help.replace: Also replaces what is not air (-r).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.description: Surface stretched between 2 and 6 curves: awnings, sails, tarps or hanging bridges. /komaedit loft
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.material: Block or palette, as a gradient from the first curve to the last.
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.interpolati: How it goes from one curve to the next (-i).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.sag: How much the middle of each span hangs; on auto, 15 %% of the span.
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.profile: Slabs and stairs on the surface (-w).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.closed: Joins the last curve to the first (-cerrar).
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.curves: Paths saved with /komaedit path save, separated by spaces.
gui.komaedit.tools.loft.help.count: How many curves the current points are split into.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.description: Stamps relief: 80 stamps in 14 categories (mountains, canyons, dunes, islands…). As a brush, one per click and each a little different; over the selection, one that covers it. /komaedit pincel heightmap · /komaedit relieve
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.stamp: The shape to stamp. Pick a category or type in the search; the star keeps it in your favourites.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.custom: Uses your own PNG from config/komaedit/heightmaps instead of the gallery.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.height: How high the stamp rises; on auto, its natural height for that radius (a low hill, a tall peak).
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.mode: Add raises the shape; subtract removes it; maximum raises it without sinking what is already higher; flatten sets the ground to the stamp; smooth blends edges and seams. Left click does the opposite.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.palette: Blocks for what changes, by slope and height. "The category's": snow on mountains, sand on dunes, strata on mesas…
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.intensity: How much of the shape each click leaves, to build it up little by little.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.neutral: The grey that neither rises nor sinks; on auto, the stamp's own.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.brush_prev: Each click leaves its brush preview (-p).
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.description: Ramp from the first to the last point (or //pos1 to //pos2): fills below and cuts above, without steps. /komaedit terreno rampa
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.help.profile: Flat section with a transition, or embankment.
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.help.transition: The strip that blends the ramp into the terrain on each side.
gui.komaedit.tools.ramp.help.mask: WorldEdit mask on the surface block (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.river.description: Carves a channel along the path, with soft banks and water that never climbs. /komaedit terreno rio
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.width: How wide the bed of the channel is.
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.depth: How deep it is under the terrain.
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.walls: How steep the channel's slopes are.
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.transition: How wide the outer slope is, where it blends into the terrain.
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.level: How high the liquid reaches from the bed.
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.smoothing: How even the bed comes out along its length.
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.follow: The bed follows the point heights (-y).
gui.komaedit.tools.river.help.mask: WorldEdit mask on the surface block (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.description: Physical erosion: drops carving channels, slopes crumbling, or both. Over the selection or as a brush. /komaedit terreno erosion
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.help.iteratio: How much it erodes: more drops or more passes.
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.help.strength: How much each drop or pass tears away and carries.
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.help.angle: The slope it holds without crumbling.
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.help.mask: WorldEdit mask on the surface block (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.description: Text in blocks with font, border and slabs and stairs, where you click. Never removes blocks. /komaedit text
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.font: Built-in fonts and those in config/komaedit/fonts (-f).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.size: How tall the capital letters come out.
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.thickness: How far the letters stick out.
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.border: An outline around the letters; 0, none.
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.border_mate: What the outline around the letters is made of.
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.orientation: Standing, lying or by where you aim: in the Studio, the face you click (wall, ground or ceiling).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.spacing: How far apart the letters are.
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.line_spacin: How far apart the lines are.
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.profile: Slabs and stairs on the edges (-w).
gui.komaedit.tools.text.help.mask: Only where the mask accepts, e.g. air (-m).
gui.komaedit.tools.analyze.description: Counts the selection blocks and their survival cost; the list shows here and in a CSV. /komaedit analyze
gui.komaedit.tools.analyze.help.lines: How many lines it shows in chat; here you see them all.
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.description: Every block you place or break by hand is repeated in its symmetric copies, with the state mirrored. /komaedit symmetry
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.help.mode: Mirrors in X, Z, Y or their combinations, or radial.
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.help.arms: How many arms the radial symmetry has.
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.help.mirror_: Adds the up ↔ down mirror to the radial (radial n y).
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.descript: Hand-building capabilities, like the Z menu: replace, tweak, extrude, smear, place in the air, long reach, fast place and no updates.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.help.ang: How far away you place blocks in the air.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.help.rea: How far you reach to place and break blocks.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.help.ext: At most how many blocks each layer places when extruding.
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.center_elsew: The center is in another dimension: %s
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.no_center: No center: turning it on uses your block
gui.komaedit.tools.symmetry.worldedit.he: Your WorldEdit and KomaEdit edits (//set, //paste, Build, brushes…) also write their copies, in the same //undo.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.unavaila: The server has not sent the capability state yet.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.family.h: Replace changes the material and keeps the shape: with spruce in hand, an oak stair becomes a spruce stair.
gui.komaedit.tools.capabilities.match.he: Block type or exact state when looking for the layer to extrude.
gui.komaedit.tools.materials.none: Press Count: the selection list will show here.
gui.komaedit.tools.materials.total: %s blocks · %s types · in survival %s items, %s slots ≈ %s chests
gui.komaedit.tools.materials.copy.help: Copies the list to the clipboard, like [COPY] in chat.
gui.komaedit.stage.blueprints.subtitle: Your library and the server's: load, place and stamp
gui.komaedit.blueprint.empty: No blueprints yet. Copy something with //copy and save it with /komaedit blueprint save <name> [tags].
gui.komaedit.blueprint.pick: Pick a blueprint from the grid to load, place or stamp it.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.search: Words from the name or an exact #tag; Esc clears, Enter picks the first. Shortcut: /
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.scope: All, only yours or only the server's shared ones.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.save_clipboa: Opens the chat with /komaedit blueprint save so you can name and tag it.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.tag: #%s · %s blueprints. Click: filter by this tag (again to remove it).
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.load: To the WorldEdit clipboard: //paste or /komaedit place Clipboard.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.place: Places it where you stand with a preview; confirm with /komaedit confirm.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.stamp: Puts the stamp brush with this blueprint in your hand: right click on the ground.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.stamp_tag: The stamp brush with every blueprint in %s, at random.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.radius: Auto: one blueprint on the clicked block. With more, the brush spreads several in that radius without touching.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.share: Copies it to the server blueprints (servidor/…) so everyone can use it.
gui.komaedit.help.blueprint.denied: You lack the permission for this.
gui.komaedit.status.blueprint.stamp: Stamp brush with %s in your hand
gui.komaedit.blocks.hint: Type to search · Enter picks the first · Esc closes
gui.komaedit.blocks.look_nothing: You are not looking at a block
gui.komaedit.blocks.looking: Use the one you look at: %s
gui.komaedit.help.top.history: World changes: undo or redo up to a point (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y)
gui.komaedit.help.top.palette: Command palette (Ctrl+K): stages, tools, presets, figures, blueprints and themes
gui.komaedit.history.title: World changes
gui.komaedit.palette.placeholder: Stage, tool, preset, figure or blueprint…
gui.komaedit.palette.hint: Arrows: choose · Enter: open · Esc: close
gui.komaedit.preview.mode.off.help: Build changes the world right away.
gui.komaedit.preview.mode.build.help: Build shows the preview; Confirm (Enter) applies it.
gui.komaedit.preview.mode.live.help: The default. Build shows the preview and, while it is shown, every settings change redoes it (the ghost stays where you left it). Only for small builds: selections up to 64,000 blocks and figures under 250,000.
gui.komaedit.preview.mode.cycle: Click: change · Right click: no preview
gui.komaedit.tools.block.eyedropper: Use the block you look at
gui.komaedit.tools.more.help: What you change less often. On the right, how many there are or how many differ from the default.
gui.komaedit.shortcut.palette: Command palette: jump to any stage, tool, preset, figure, blueprint or theme
gui.komaedit.tools.pick.help: Choose the tool above; its settings then show up here.
gui.komaedit.help.panel_width:
Panel width: %s%% of the screen
Drag the edge to resize it · right click: default
key.komaedit.repeat: Repeat the last operation here (Shift: with preview)
gui.komaedit.world.title: KomaEdit · in the world
gui.komaedit.world.fade.tooltip: The preview gets lighter when you are on top of it, so you can see what is behind.
gui.komaedit.world.selection.tooltip: The WorldEdit selection with thin lines. Off by default with WorldEditCUI so you do not see it twice.
gui.komaedit.world.dimensions.tooltip: Width, height and length on the selection and on the preview box.
gui.komaedit.world.path_numbers.tooltip: The number of each point above it; with many points, one in five.
gui.komaedit.world.brush.tooltip: With a brush in your hand, its radius on the surface you look at.
gui.komaedit.world.symmetry.tooltip: The symmetry planes and axis around you, without particles.
gui.komaedit.world.alignment_guide.toolt: With a placement brush (place, scatter, array) in your hand, arrows on the block you look at: green the primary (the structure's up), red the secondary and blue the third axis.
gui.komaedit.guide.waiting: right click: where · then left click: which way
gui.komaedit.guide.invalid: primary and secondary on the same line: change one or use -x
gui.komaedit.guide.random: random: every placement comes out different
gui.komaedit.world.sounds.tooltip: A short sound when you confirm, when a long edit finishes and when something fails.
key.komaedit.ghost_paste: Paste the clipboard as a ghost (default Ctrl+V)
gui.komaedit.ghost.title: Ghost · %s
gui.komaedit.ghost.opened: Ghost of %s: move it with the gizmo, the arrow keys or the wheel ·
gui.komaedit.ghost.no_tip: This object can't be tipped over (it has stairs, slabs, doors…)
gui.komaedit.ghost.no_target: You aren't looking at a block within 192 blocks
gui.komaedit.ghost.hint: %s or right click places · Ctrl+click: copy · Esc cancels
gui.komaedit.ghost.chat.place.tooltip: Places exactly what you see (Enter or right click)
gui.komaedit.ghost.chat.copy.tooltip: Places a copy and keeps moving it (Ctrl+right click or Ctrl+Enter)
gui.komaedit.ghost.chat.cancel.tooltip: Removes it without placing anything (Esc or Backspace)
gui.komaedit.ghost.chat.keep.tooltip: Keep existing: only places blocks where there is air now (Ctrl+E)
gui.komaedit.ghost.chat.air.tooltip: Paste the object's air: clears whatever is in those positions (Ctrl+X)
gui.komaedit.ghost.chat.ground.tooltip: Snap to ground: moving it lowers it onto the terrain (Ctrl+B)
gui.komaedit.ghost.button.place.tooltip: Places exactly what you see, in a single //undo (Enter). Ctrl+Enter places a copy and keeps going
gui.komaedit.ghost.button.cancel.tooltip: Removes the ghost without placing anything (Esc)
gui.komaedit.ghost.button.keep.tooltip: Only places blocks where there is air now (Ctrl+E)
gui.komaedit.ghost.button.air.tooltip: The object's air clears whatever is in those positions (Ctrl+X)
gui.komaedit.ghost.button.ground.tooltip: When moved, it drops (or rises) to rest on the terrain (Ctrl+B)
gui.komaedit.ghost.studio.help: Click in the world: moves it there; hold and drag to slide it over the terrain · drag the arrows to move along an axis, the cube on the ground and the rings to rotate · wheel: closer or farther · arrow keys and Page Up/Down: one block at a time (Shift: 5) · Ctrl+R rotates · Ctrl+F flips · Enter places · Esc cancels
gui.komaedit.world.gizmo.tooltip: Paste, place, blueprints, shapes, trees, rocks, roofs and text appear as a ghost with a gizmo so you can move them before placing. "With -v": only when the command has -v; without it they place at once
gui.komaedit.world.gizmo_wheel.tooltip: With a ghost on screen, the mouse wheel pushes it away or pulls it closer along your view instead of changing the hotbar slot
gui.komaedit.status.click.no_block: Point the cursor at a block in the world
Mountain with ridges and slopes carved by erosion
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.pico.hel: Sharp, lonely peak with a slender summit and long skirts
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cumbre_d: Two summits with a saddle between them
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.montana_: Old range: rounded, worn ridges with gentle valleys
Spur: the tip of a range coming down towards you
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cordille: A long ridge with summits and side spurs
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.sierra.h: Jagged sierra: a row of sharp peaks
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cordille: Range that bends forward in an arc
Three ridges meeting at a summit
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cordones: Parallel ridges with valleys between them (folded relief)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.loma.hel: Elongated hill along your view, steeper at the front
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.lomas.he: Several low hills that run into each other
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cerro.he: Hill with a broad, almost flat top: room for a village
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.ondulaci: Gentle undulations that raise and lower the ground
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.mesa.hel: Flat-topped mesa with cut edges and scree at its foot
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.meseta.h: Broad plateau with its edge bitten by ravines
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cerro_te: Butte: flat-topped tower on its skirt
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.mesa_esc: Mesa in three tiers, like rock layers
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.mesa_par: Mesa split in two by a narrow cleft
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.acantila: Cliff: a wall rising in front of you
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.ensenada: Cove: cliffs around a bay that opens towards you
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.promonto: Headland: a tongue of high land with sheer sides
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.farallon: Cliff with loose sea stacks in front
Scree cone: debris fan at the foot of a wall
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.garganta: Narrow, deep gorge with near-vertical walls (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.valle_fl: V-shaped valley with tributaries running into it (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.hoz.help: Horseshoe bend: the river loops around a spur (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.canon_ci: Box canyon that starts in a cirque and opens towards you (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.crater.h: Impact crater: high rim, sunken floor and ejecta rays
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.crater_c: Large flat-floored crater with a peak in the middle
Caldera sunk in steps with a dome on its floor (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.dolina.h: Sinkhole: round funnel that sinks the ground
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.crateres: Field of small craters overlapping each other
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cuenca.h: Shallow basin with lobed shores: the place for a lake (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.volcan.h: Volcano with a summit crater and radial ravines
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.volcan_e: Shield volcano: broad, gentle slopes and lobed lava flows
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cono_cen: Cinder cone: small, steep, with a big crater
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.volcan_r: Volcano with a collapsed flank open towards you
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.volcan_d: Volcano with a secondary cone on its slope
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.colada.h: Lava flow: a tongue with raised edges and ridges at its front
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.duna.hel: Crescent dune (barchan) with its steep face towards your view
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.dunas.he: Field of transverse dunes with sinuous crests
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.duna_est: Star dune: sharp-crested arms around a peak
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.duna_lin: Linear dune (seif): a long, sinuous crest
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.duna_par: Parabolic dune: a horseshoe with its arms towards you
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.barjanes: Several small barchans in a row
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.isla.hel: Island with a low beach, ragged coast and a hill in the middle
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.atolon.h: Atoll: low ring with islets and passes to the sea
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cayo.hel: Cay: low sandy islet with a curved spit
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.isla_med: Crescent island: the rim of a caldera open to the sea
Tombolo: two islets joined by a sand bar
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.bancales: Long ridge with many narrow farm terraces
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.anfiteat: Amphitheatre: a pit in stepped rings (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.terrazas: Valley with river terraces on both sides of the channel (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.circo.he: Glacial cirque: high-walled horseshoe open towards you
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.valle.he: U-shaped glacial valley: wide floor and steepening walls (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.cuerno.h: Horn: pyramidal peak carved by three cirques
Terminal moraine: an arc of debris left by the ice
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.drumlins: Drumlin field: elongated hills along the flow of the ice
Glacier tongue with crevasses and moraines along its edges
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.aguja.he: Tall, thin rock spire on a mound
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.agujas.h: Hoodoos: several columns of different heights
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.domo.hel: Rounded granite dome with onion-like sheets
Crag of broken rock in faces and blocks
Wrinkles: fine folds that break flat ground (raises and lowers)
Network of cracks, like dry mud or cracked rock (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.carcavas: Rills: branching grooves carved by water (sinks)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.barranco: Slope crossed by gullies running down towards you
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.rizos.he: Sand or mud ripples (raises and lowers)
gui.komaedit.tools.option.stamp.escalone: Rock ledges on the slopes (raises and lowers)
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.variation: How much each click changes (turn, size, mirror and fine detail), so no two copies look the same.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.lock_seed: Every click comes out exactly the same, with the seed below. "Random" picks another; in game, Shift+F.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.seed: Where the variation of each click comes from. On auto, a new one when you take the brush; Shift+F changes it in game.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.search.help: Searches every category by name or description: volcano, island, snow… Enter picks the first one.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.category.help: Which stamps are shown. Once you star one, also "Favourites".
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.favorite: Add to or remove from favourites
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.range.help: Radius 30 range: stamp it several times in a line.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.canyon.help: Radius 26 canyon with strata on its walls.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.description: Recolours the surface without changing any height: by slope, height, noise, from the centre to the edge, or with the rules of a natural palette. As a brush (hold the click and drag) or over the selection. /komaedit pincel paint · /komaedit pintar
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.paint_pale: The gradient tones, first to last; the sample shows how they blend.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.custom_pal: Any palette: ##Name, a saved one (#name) or a list like stone,andesite,tuff.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.stamp: The brush shape: circle, square or a height stamp used as a mask (bright paints more). Over the selection, with Footprint, it stretches to cover it.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.gradient: Which tone goes where: by slope (flat to steep), by height (low to high), by noise (patches), by footprint (centre to edge) or Natural, with the rules of a surface palette.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.strength: How much the colour changes with each dab; going over again builds up.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.seed: Seed of the noise and of the footprint rotation. «Random» (R) or F in game picks another.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.lock_seed: Locked, the footprint does not rotate or resize between clicks: the same stroke paints the same (Shift + F in game).
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.dab_spacin: How often a dab is left while dragging: close, one continuous stroke; apart, patches.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.hardness: How the edge of each dab ends.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.variation: How uneven the borders between tones come out, so they are not straight.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.slope_low: From which slope the first tone starts; flatter ground gets it too.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.slope_high: At which slope the last tone is reached; steeper ground gets it too.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.height_low: At which height the first tone starts; on auto, where each stroke begins.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.height_hig: At which height the last tone is reached.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.noise_size: How big the colour patches come out.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.layers: How many blocks deep from the surface are painted.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.surface_on: Only what touches the air; off, it paints everything inside the brush.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.shaped: Stairs and slabs too, keeping their shape.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.any_block: Paints any block; off, only natural terrain and the palette, so houses are left alone.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.brush_prev: Each click leaves its preview to confirm; no dragging then.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.paint_hillside: Grass on the flat and stone on the steep, the default.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.paint_peaks.he: Snow up high and rock below by height, with a mountain footprint.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.paint_desert.h: Sand and sandstones by slope, with the dunes footprint.
gui.komaedit.help.option.palette: The gradient's blocks, from one colour to another.
gui.komaedit.help.option.metric: What the colours follow: along the figure, how exposed it is, hollows, edges…
gui.komaedit.figure.more.help: What you touch less: the figure's roll, the tube, how the variations change, the gradient's spread and the clean-up. On the right, how many are no longer default.
gui.komaedit.help.gradient: Several blocks going from one colour to another along the figure, instead of a single one.
gui.komaedit.help.gradient_axis: Which way the gradient goes: along X, Y or Z, or following the path.
gui.komaedit.help.gradient_reverse: Starts the gradient from the other colour.
gui.komaedit.variations.reset.help: The figure is the same from start to end again: not tapered, not twisted and nothing on top.
gui.komaedit.variation.taper.effect: Thinner (or thicker) towards the end of the path
gui.komaedit.variation.twist.effect: Turns around itself along the path
gui.komaedit.variation.ground.effect: Drops to the ground and follows it
gui.komaedit.variation.on_build: Shows in the ghost when you build: the hologram does not show it.
gui.komaedit.variation.click_on: Click: turn it on (the hologram shows it right away)
gui.komaedit.variation.ground.floor.help: Each point drops to the ground below it.
gui.komaedit.variation.ground.ceiling.he: Each point rises to the ceiling above it (caves, bridges).
gui.komaedit.variation.ground.nearest.he: Each point goes to the nearest surface in any direction (walls too). Shows when you build.
gui.komaedit.variation.copied.note: Uses what you copied with //copy (a lamp, a post). Shows in the ghost when you build.
gui.komaedit.hint.number: Wheel or − +: change · drag the number (Shift: fine) · click: type it · right-click: default
gui.komaedit.hint.cycle: Click or wheel: next · ‹: previous · right-click: default
gui.komaedit.hint.toggle: Click: on or off · right-click: default
gui.komaedit.hint.block: Click: pick from the library · eyedropper: the block you look at · Alt+click in the world: that block
gui.komaedit.hint.variation: Click: on or off · right-click: off
gui.komaedit.hint.world.none: A click in the world does nothing here
gui.komaedit.hint.world.ghost: Click: bring it there · drag: move it · Enter: place
gui.komaedit.hint.world.points: Click: new point · drag a point: move it · drag a segment: one in between
gui.komaedit.hint.world.select: Drag: select · pull a face: adjust · double-click: connected same blocks
gui.komaedit.hint.world.paint: Click or hold: paint with the brush
gui.komaedit.hint.world.common: Alt+click: copy that block · right-click: turn the camera
gui.komaedit.status.eyedropper.color_fro: Gradient from %s · with Shift, the last one
gui.komaedit.status.node.grabbed: Point %s · drag to move it · its arrows raise or lower it
gui.komaedit.status.node.inserted: New point between %s and %s · drag to move it
gui.komaedit.status.path.full: There are already %s points, the maximum
gui.komaedit.hint.world.legend: What the mouse does in the world
gui.komaedit.shortcut.world_click: What the footer says: a point, build there, select or paint
gui.komaedit.shortcut.world_drag_point: Move it over the terrain (Path and Figures)
gui.komaedit.shortcut.world_drag_segment: Insert a point in between and move it
gui.komaedit.shortcut.world_select: Select a box (selection tools and Colour)
gui.komaedit.shortcut.world_face: Make the selection longer or shorter on that side
gui.komaedit.shortcut.world_magic: Select the connected blocks of the same kind
gui.komaedit.shortcut.world_paint: With a brush in your hand, keep painting
gui.komaedit.shortcut.world_eyedropper: The clicked block becomes the material
gui.komaedit.hint.world.brush_first: “%s” gives you the brush; then click here to paint
gui.komaedit.path.first: Click in the world to place the first point; with two you can already build.
gui.komaedit.recipe.how: Save keeps the figure you have now: its shape, size, material and variations. A click on a saved one puts it back in Figures.
gui.komaedit.recipe.load_hint: Click: put it in Figures · ×: delete it
gui.komaedit.instance.how: Every figure you build stays here. Pick one, change it in Figures and press Update (or Delete to remove it from the world).
gui.komaedit.instance.pick_hint: Click: pick it to change or delete it
gui.komaedit.figure.need_points: %s points missing: click in the world to place them.
gui.komaedit.welcome.intro.title: First steps in the Studio
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.intro: In two minutes you plant a tree, raise a mountain and paint it. Nothing is placed until you confirm it, and Ctrl+Z undoes it all.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.intro.show: You can't build here (survival or no permission), so I'll show you where everything is without placing anything. Two minutes.
gui.komaedit.welcome.start.help: Five short steps on the world; each one moves on when you do it.
gui.komaedit.welcome.later.help: Come back any time from “?” or with /komaedit tutorial.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.tree_pick: Press “Plant a tree”. Everything you build starts by picking the tool here.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.tree_click: Click the ground on the left: the tree shows up there as a ghost, not placed yet.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.tree_click.pat: You have path points: press “Plant” and one goes on each point, not placed yet.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.tree_look: In creative, a click on the ground would plant it as a ghost: its arrows move it and “Place” puts it down.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.ghost_move: Drag one of its arrows (or click somewhere else) to leave it exactly where you want it.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.ghost_place: Press “Place” (or Enter). Only now is it really placed, and Ctrl+Z takes it away.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.ghost_place.pr: This is a preview: press “Confirm” (or Enter) and only then is it placed. Ctrl+Z takes it away.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.stamp_pick: Press “Stamp terrain”: it raises mountains, craters or dunes with one click.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.stamp_choose: Pick a stamp, Mountain for example: the picture is the shape it will have.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.stamp_brush: Press “To brush”: it puts the brush with that stamp in your hand.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.stamp_click: Click the ground: you'll see the mountain before anything changes.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.stamp_seed: Press “Random”: another seed, another mountain with the same shape.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.stamp_again: Click the ground again to see the new mountain.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.stamp_apply: Like it? “Apply” puts it in the world; “Discard” removes it without touching anything.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.stamp_look: “To brush” would give you the brush: a click on the ground shows the mountain and then you apply it.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.paint_pick: Press “Paint”: it covers the relief with blocks that follow its shape.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.paint_preset: Press “Peaks” in the row below: snow up high, rock and grass further down.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.paint_brush: Press “To brush” to take this brush.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.paint_click: Click the mountain: you'll see how it looks painted before it's painted.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.paint_apply: “Apply” really paints it; “Discard” leaves it as it was.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.paint_look: With the brush in hand, a click on the mountain shows how it looks and then you paint it.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.undo_open: Press the clock at the top: everything you changed in the world is there.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.undo_do: Press “Undo” (or Ctrl+Z): the last change goes away. “Redo” brings it back.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.undo_do.empty: There's nothing to undo yet. When there is, “Undo” (or Ctrl+Z) takes the last change away.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.undo_look: What you change in the world shows up here: a click on a row undoes back to it.
gui.komaedit.welcome.done.title: All done!
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.done: Now you know what you'll always do: pick, see before placing, confirm and undo. This guide comes back from “?” or with /komaedit tutorial.
gui.komaedit.welcome.beat.done.show: Now you know where everything is. When you can build, run it again from “?” or with /komaedit tutorial.
gui.komaedit.welcome.apply.help: Places what the brush preview shows (/komaedit pincel aplicar). Ctrl+Z takes it away.
gui.komaedit.welcome.discard.help: Removes the preview without touching the world (/komaedit pincel cancelar).
gui.komaedit.welcome.skip_step.help: Moves on to the next step without doing this one.
gui.komaedit.welcome.skip_all.help: Closes the guide. It comes back from “?” or with /komaedit tutorial.
gui.komaedit.welcome.notice.skipped: No permission for %s: that step is skipped.
gui.komaedit.welcome.notice.cancelled: Cancelled: nothing was placed. Try again.
gui.komaedit.welcome.notice.discarded: Discarded: the world is just as it was.
gui.komaedit.welcome.skipped: Welcome skipped: it comes back from “?” or with /komaedit tutorial
gui.komaedit.welcome.relaunch.help: Runs the first-steps guide again (also with /komaedit tutorial).
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.description: Fixes on what is already there: snow, drain, flood, let fall, deinfest, keep the leaves, waterlog, wax or change the biome. Over the selection or as a brush. /komaedit retocar
gui.komaedit.tools.use.brush.help: Puts it on a brush in your hand: each click in the world applies it there and, holding it, keeps going.
gui.komaedit.tools.use.selection.help: Once, over the whole WorldEdit selection.
gui.komaedit.tools.use.click.help: Once, where you click in the world (or at each point of the path).
gui.komaedit.tools.tree.help.use: Where you click you get one (or one at each point of the path); as a brush, one per click, without going back to the Studio.
gui.komaedit.tools.rock.help.use: Where you click you get one (or one at each point of the path); as a brush, one per click, without going back to the Studio.
gui.komaedit.tools.stamp.help.use: As a brush, a stamp on every click; over the selection, one stretched to cover it, without touching anything outside.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.use: As a brush you paint where you click and drag; over the selection, all of it at once. The settings are the same.
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.help.use: Over the selection, all at once; as a brush, around each click.
gui.komaedit.tools.erosion.help.radius: How wide the brush erodes around the click.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.use: Over the selection, all at once; as a brush, around each click (and while you hold it). The settings are the same.
gui.komaedit.tools.paint.help.palette: The surface rules: grass on flats, stone on slopes, snow on top, sand on the shore and dirt below.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.touch: Which fix is done; each one shows only its own settings.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.radius: How wide the brush touches up around the click.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.level: How high the water goes: all the way up (the top of the selection; as a brush, the clicked block), your feet or a height.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.leaves: Leaves that do not decay even without a trunk nearby, or that decay again.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.wet: Waterlogs everything that takes water (stairs, slabs, fences…) or dries it.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.wax: Waxes copper and signs (they no longer oxidise or can be edited) or removes the wax.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.mask: Only on blocks the mask accepts.
gui.komaedit.tools.preset.sea_level.help: Floods up to the default sea height.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.layers: How thick the snow cover is.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.drift: How much the snow is smoothed on slopes; 0, an even blanket.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.fill: How much the holes are filled.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.shade: Extra layers where it is in the shade.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.height: Extra layers at the highest part of the selection.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.plants: Also covers short grass and ferns.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.level_y: The world height the water reaches.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.offset: How many blocks above or below your feet the water reaches.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.blocks_o: Only waterlogs blocks, without filling air.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.biome: Type to search the server biomes.
gui.komaedit.tools.touchup.help.vertical: Paints each cell column from the world bottom to the top.
key.komaedit.display_step: Displays: move step 1, 1/4, 1/16 or free (default Ctrl+5)
key.komaedit.display_angle: Displays: rotation step 15°, 5° or free (default Ctrl+6)
key.komaedit.display_copy: Displays: copy rotation and scale (default Ctrl+C)
key.komaedit.display_paste: Displays: paste rotation and scale (default Ctrl+V)
key.komaedit.display_group: Displays: group; with Shift, ungroup (default Ctrl+G)
key.komaedit.display_forward: Displays: one step forward (default Up arrow)
key.komaedit.display_back: Displays: one step back (default Down arrow)
key.komaedit.display_left: Displays: one step left (default Left arrow)
key.komaedit.display_right: Displays: one step right (default Right arrow)
key.komaedit.display_up: Displays: one step up (default Page Up)
key.komaedit.display_down: Displays: one step down (default Page Down)
gui.komaedit.display.hud.title: Displays
gui.komaedit.display.hud.hint: drag the gizmo · Alt: no steps · Ctrl+1/2/3 tool · Delete removes · Esc deselects
gui.komaedit.display.hud.hint_empty: click a display to select it · Shift+click adds · Alt+click: just that one, not its group
gui.komaedit.display.opened: Display editor: click one to select it and drag it with the gizmo ·
gui.komaedit.display.copied: Rotation and scale copied: Ctrl+V pastes them on the selection
gui.komaedit.display.nothing_copied: Nothing copied: press Ctrl+C with a display selected
gui.komaedit.display.chat.move.tooltip: Drag an arrow to move along an axis or the cube to move along the ground (Ctrl+1)
gui.komaedit.display.chat.rotate.tooltip: Drag a ring to rotate step by step; clicking a ring rotates one step (Ctrl+2)
gui.komaedit.display.chat.scale.tooltip: Drag a cube to scale along that axis or the center one to scale evenly (Ctrl+3)
gui.komaedit.display.chat.local.tooltip: The gizmo uses the rotated object's axes (Ctrl+4)
gui.komaedit.display.chat.global.tooltip: The gizmo uses the world axes; moving snaps its corner to the step grid (Ctrl+4)
gui.komaedit.display.chat.close.tooltip: Closes the display editor (the selection is dropped)
gui.komaedit.tools.display.description: Loose blocks, items and texts against the block you look at, moved, rotated and scaled with the gizmo to 1/16 of a block: plants in pots, items on tables, paintings and signs. Click one to select it. /komaedit display
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.kind: What is placed: a block, the item in your hand or a text.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.block: The display's block; empty, the one in your hand.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.item_mod: How the item looks: in a frame, as it is, as an icon, dropped on the ground or on a head.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.display_: What the sign says; \n breaks the line and &c, &l… give colour and bold.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.backgrou: The background behind the letters: Minecraft's, none or black.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.text_sha: A shadow behind each letter, as in chat.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.align: Which side short lines gather to.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.move_ste: How far it jumps when moved with the gizmo and the arrows; its corner lands on that grid. Hold Alt to move freely.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.angle_st: How much each step of the rings turns.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.local: On, the gizmo follows the rotated object's axes; off, the world's.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.brightne: A fixed light so it looks the same by day and night; auto, the light of its spot.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.shadow_r: The round shadow it casts on the ground.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.view_ran: How far away it can be seen: more, from further.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.billboar: Whether it always faces the camera: fixed never turns, vertical turns sideways, center faces you.
gui.komaedit.tools.display.help.glow: A bright outline that shows through walls.
gui.komaedit.tools.option.item_mode.head: Head
gui.komaedit.tools.action.display_edit.h: Closes the display editor (choosing this card opens it): click a display to select it (Shift adds), drag the gizmo; Ctrl+1/2/3 move, rotate, scale.
Gives the gizmo the card's move step, rotation step and axes.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.display_look.h: Gives the selection the brightness, shadow, view range, billboard and outline from «More settings».
gui.komaedit.tools.action.display_duplic: Copies the selection in place and selects the copies to move them (Ctrl+D).
Joins the selection: clicking one selects the group and it moves as one (Ctrl+G).
gui.komaedit.tools.action.display_ungrou: Takes the selection out of its group (Ctrl+Shift+G).
Removes the rotation and sets the scale to 1 without moving its center.
gui.komaedit.tools.action.display_delete: Deletes the selection (Delete); //undo brings it back.
